cv.name: Daniel Okafor
cv.headline: Senior Legal Counsel | Insurance Regulation & Privacy
cv.summary: Ontario lawyer (called 2016) with ten years across litigation, commercial contracts and in-house regulatory work. For the last five years has also run the privacy program of a mid-sized insurer, so equally at home as counsel or as a privacy and compliance lead.

experience.title: Senior Legal Counsel, Privacy & Regulatory
bullets: Advise business units on FSRA and OSFI requirements, distribution agreements and outsourcing contracts
Act as designated Privacy Officer under PIPEDA; lead breach response and privacy impact assessments
Negotiated 40+ vendor and reinsurance-related agreements per year with minimal use of outside counsel
Built a contract playbook that reduced average review time from 9 to 4 business days
Train claims and underwriting staff on privacy and complaint-handling obligations

experience.title: Associate
bullets: Commercial litigation and insurance defence files from pleadings through mediation
Second chair on two Superior Court trials

experience.title: Articling Student
bullets: Research memos, motions and discoveries for the insurance defence group

education.school: Osgoode Hall Law School, York University

skills: PIPEDA, privacy impact assessments, breach response
certifications: Law Society of Ontario, called to the Bar 2016
